description: This file declares functions, macros, and includes used for case-insensitive string comparisons and manipulations within the curl library. It primarily provides utility functions and macros related to string case comparisons, often used internally in the curl project.

methods.name: Curl_raw_toupper
methods.description: Converts a character to uppercase in a locale-independent way.

methods.name: Curl_raw_tolower
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase in a locale-independent way.

methods.name: Curl_strntoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase up to n characters.

methods.name: Curl_strntolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase up to n characters.

methods.name: Curl_safecmp
methods.description: Performs a safe comparison of two strings, returning a boolean.

methods.name: Curl_timestrcmp
methods.description: Compares two time strings, returning an integer indicating the lexicographical order.
